specs.title: Dispatcher Cache Interface (Memory-Tier Architecture)
specs.count_check: 001: 52 aligned + 12 drifted (new) + 8 carried + 2 not verifiable = 74 (57 FR + 17 SC); 002: 27 + 3 + 2 + 13 = 45 (36 FR + 9 SC); total 119

drifted.spec_text: Write / cache management: populate, batch_populate, remove, touch, promote_to_memory_tier (inventory claims to be full)
drifted.actual: trait also has clear_memory_tier, clear_all, tier_event_stats

drifted.spec_text: The `initialize` method MUST validate that the `dispatch_map` and `memory_tier` receptacles are bound before proceeding.
drifted.actual: a failed initialize leaves max_eviction_attempts/store_backpressure_ms unchanged (committed just before initialized)

drifted.spec_text: (Exception, tracked as align task A-04: the no-drives `promote_and_serve` does not re-register the entry and keeps its slot.)
drifted.actual: no-drives promote_and_serve and batch_lookup deliver, then promote_block_to_memory_tier in place; release on failure

drifted.spec_text: it creates a memory-tier slot with zero-copied data, performs a direct GPU DMA from the slot, and re-registers the entry.
drifted.actual: slot not zeroed; in-place re-register; also batch_lookup; release+fail on error

drifted.spec_text: after GPU and memory-tier are ready ... CUDA-pin and SPDK-register ... Registration failure MUST be logged as a warning
drifted.actual: aligned in substance (fix 2); precision: registration also without SPDK/drives, where gpu-services only CUDA-pins (9a79224a1); failure does not fail initialize

drifted.spec_text: A single `AtomicU64` warm stream (`warm_stream`) is retained as a fallback;
drifted.actual: warm_stream is created/destroyed but never read; unknown-device warm copies are synchronous
drifted.fix_note: pre-existing on unstable; fix 7 briefly added the only reader

drifted.spec_text: retried locally a few times (up to 5) rather than collapsed into `KeyNotFound`
drifted.actual: exhausted retry -> Timeout / IoError, never KeyNotFound, not forwarded to remote, ERROR attribution
batch_lookup and check also return Timeout (and check IoError)

drifted.spec_text: When the device is unknown (`-1`) the paths fall back to the shared pipeline-ring / `warm_stream` streams.
drifted.actual: cold single-entry paths: pipeline-ring streams; scatter-gather: two new streams; warm paths: no stream (sync dma_copy_to_device)

drifted.spec_text: the three MUST sum to the served count for any interval ... remote_lookup_hits counted when the remote fetch succeeds — not when delivered
drifted.actual: single-key path now in the partition; remote counted at fetch so a failed remote delivery breaks the partition

drifted.spec_text: `lookup_hits_dram + lookup_hits_ssd + remote_lookup_hits` MUST equal the served-key count over the same interval
drifted.actual: exceeds it by the number of failed remote deliveries

drifted.spec_text: retain and report the first error per job while continuing to drain outstanding completions
drifted.actual: tagless Timeout attributed after the loop to the incomplete job only; channel faults still fail the drive

drifted.spec_text: The read targets the drive chosen by the write path's placement hash (`drive_index`)
drifted.actual: drive recorded in the SSD location (select_drive); drive_index removed

drifted_carried.spec_text: returns a `GpuStream` handle instead of blocking on the H2D DMA transfer ... For SSD promotion paths the copy completes synchronously and a null stream is returned.
drifted_carried.actual: every path blocks and returns the null stream (fix 7 reverted; same as unstable). Caller contract (sync on non-null) is honoured; non-blocking promise is not
drifted_carried.resolution: deferred to the separate lookup_async issue (209b01de5); no proposal; note N-13

drifted.spec_text: The aggregate counters MUST agree with the per-entry attribution in the same responses.
drifted.actual: a failed remote delivery is ERROR but counted in remote_lookup_hits

drifted.spec_text: evictions_blocked_unpersisted when it refuses for want of an ssd_offset
drifted.actual: InvalidState -> unpersisted; other refusals -> neither; variant/third cause unstated

drifted.spec_text: (p2p only) Its background MemoryTierEvictor is still not counted ... MUST stay declared
drifted.actual: dispatcher's background evictor also records neither cause; undeclared

drifted_carried.location: value tests exist for Dram, Miss, Ssd (repair_test_nvme_timeout_fails_whole_drive.rs:769), Error (:749; repair_test_transient_map_error.rs:780; repair_test_sync_failure_error.rs:532); none for Remote or SizeMismatch

align_defects.problem: timed-out read's slot freed at once; a late drive write can land in a reused slot
absorb and swap under separate locks; concurrent reader double-counts
InvalidState also means not-MemoryTier; cold-prep slot counted unpersisted

closed.status: resolved in code by 60838384e; spec reference removed by B-41

notes.text: An asynchronous lookup_async must hold the entry's read pin until its copy has completed, not merely been queued, and count the hit only then; the synchronous lookup delegates and syncs afterwards (src/lib.rs:2477-2488). FR-039 step (2) states this rule for batch_lookup. Needs an interface decision; deferred with fix 7.
